reference_sql:
SELECT split_part(sku, '-', 1) AS sku_prefix, COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM products
GROUP BY split_part(sku, '-', 1)
alternatives:
WITH prefixes AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT split_part(sku, '-', 1) AS sku_prefix
  FROM products
)
SELECT sku_prefix, COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM prefixes
GROUP BY sku_prefix
SELECT substring(sku, 1, strpos(sku, '-') - 1) AS sku_prefix, COUNT(*) AS n_products FROM products GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql:
WITH prefixes AS (  -- one row per product
  SELECT split_part(sku, '-', 1) AS sku_prefix
  FROM products
)
SELECT sku_prefix, COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM prefixes
GROUP BY sku_prefix
other_way.tradeoff: A named step works out each prefix once and groups by its name, but grouping by the expression needs one query only.
